Gideon, Judges. Israel faced enemies that felt too big, and a young man was hiding when an angel of the Lord said, the Lord is with thee, thou mighty man of valour. Gideon asked honest questions, then obeyed, step by small step, and God pared the army to show the victory was His, not a crowd. If you feel small, God is not asking you to fake courage—ask Him, trust His timing, and take the next true step.
